items.stem: This lecture shows teenagers the harm of being a ______ to the Internet.
items.note: 大题「一、单词拼写」第1题；横线空白，未见作答；卷面无班级/姓名/学号栏

items.stem: If you are under too much p______, you can listen to music to relax yourself.
items.note: 大题「一、单词拼写」第2题；卷面已印首字母 p，横线上手写 ressu(re)，完整单词为 pressure

items.stem: If you don't know how to ______ the problem, you can turn to you teacher.
items.note: 大题「二、单项选择」第1题；左侧页边手写字母 B；卷面印作 you teacher（疑漏印 your 的 r）

items.stem: Though the girl had trouble in hearing, she managed ______ a college degree.
items.note: 大题「二、单项选择」第2题；左侧页边手写字母 A

items.stem: It is kind ______ him ______ to me and give me so much advice to solve the problems.
items.note: 大题「二、单项选择」第3题；左侧页边手写字母 C

items.stem: With my parents' help, I can focus more ______ my schoolwork.
items.note: 大题「二、单项选择」第4题；左侧页边手写字母 D

items.stem: Too much ______ is bad for health. We should learn to relax ourselves in daily life.
items.note: 大题「二、单项选择」第5题；左侧页边手写字母 C

items.stem: Lots of young people get addicted ______ short videos, which takes up most of their spare time.
items.note: 大题「二、单项选择」第6题；左侧页边手写字母 D

items.stem: Don't touch my books, or you will ______ ______ ______.
items.cn: 别碰我的书，不然你会把它们弄乱。
items.note: 大题「三、完成句子」第1题；三条横线依次手写 mess / them / up
大题「三、完成句子」第2题；手写依次 has / a / good / habit of，habit 连笔形似 hodif，按语义读作 habit 卷面为 5 段横线，学生手写 has/a/good/habit/of 分置五空。

items.stem: It's not wise to just go ______ ______ ______ to lose weight.
items.cn: 仅仅依靠节食来减肥是不明智的。
items.note: 大题「三、完成句子」第3题；三条横线依次手写 on / a / diet

items.stem: I am writing an email to my teacher to ______ him ______ ______.
items.cn: 我正在给我的老师写邮件，向他寻求建议。
items.note: 大题「三、完成句子」第4题；第二条横线手写 advice from（语序/介词有误，正确应为 for advice） 卷面为 3 段横线，学生手写 ask/advice/from 分置三空（语序、介词均有误）。

items.stem: She is ______ ______ ______ ______ the School Food Festival.
items.cn: 她负责组织本次校园美食节。
items.note: 卷面为 4 段横线；学生手写 in/charge/of，第 4 空写「t.」（疑为 to organize 未写完）。

items.stem: 上周末，我给我爸爸买了一些茶叶。（S+V+IO+DO+A）

items.note: 大题「6. 句型翻译」第(3)题；手写作 I bought my father some tea last weekend.
